items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: I had a chance to go with Palletti but I wasn't no bum you see

ctx.x: Well I don't know about that. There was two or three fellas wanted me to when Paul Eddy was playing you know at the West End.

they came to me and they mentioned my name's Palletti so they said bring him up but they had to rehearse every day in in up in St. Charles Alley at least Exchange Alley where they give you that big sandwich and a beer you could fill up for a dime and they used to rehearse there so I told them I said what the hell I gotta work every day I ain't got no time to go to Hoey's so that's what stopped me from playing with I had a chance to go with Palletti but I wasn't no bum you see I was
